instruction:
Using ZModeler on the opened Box mesh, create a sunken top pocket and a lowered base. Open ZBrush 2025 from the desktop shortcut and continue from the supplied scene or mesh. On the top face, use Inset 0.6 and Extrude -0.2 to make a centered 0.8 x 0.8 BU pocket floor at y=0.8. Extrude the bottom face downward by 0.1 BU using a -0.1 offset, so y_min becomes -1.1. Export `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.obj`.

The output must contain one manifold object/group named Box, retain at least 95% quads, have the 0.64 BU^2 pocket floor at the stated position, and retain 3.36 BU^2 of top-rim area around the opening.

command:
import ctypes, time
user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
EnumWindowsProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
EnumChildProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
def close_error():
    wins = []
    def wcb(hwnd, lparam):
        buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(512)
        user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, 512)
        if 'ZHomePage.exe' in buf.value and 'System Error' in buf.value:
            wins.append(hwnd)
        return True
    user32.EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc(wcb), 0)
    for hwnd in wins:
        buttons = []
        def ccb(ch, lparam):
            text = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            user32.GetWindowTextW(ch, text, 128)
            user32.GetClassNameW(ch, cls, 128)
            if text.value == 'OK' or cls.value == 'Button':
                buttons.append(ch)
            return True
        user32.EnumChildWindows(hwnd, EnumChildProc(ccb), 0)
        for ch in buttons:
            user32.SendMessageW(ch, 0x00F5, 0, 0)
time.sleep(95)
for _ in range(4):
    close_error()
    time.sleep(2)
